title: Kina Grihakarya Purna Roopma Hataunuparcha
text: Yas barsha mero sano bhaile harek sanjh pura dui ghanta grihakarya paune thalyo, ra usko natija gat barsha ko tulanama jhan khaskiyo. Yesaile nai dekhaucha ki grihakaryale vidyarthilai sikna maddat gardaina — baru yesle uniharulai thakit ra school prati kam ruchi bhako banaucha. Maile hereko harek kakshakothama shikshakले ramrosanga padhaera ra schoolmai abhyas garna dinda nai vidyarthile ramro garthe, gharma hoina. Schoolharule grihakarya purna roopma hataunuparcha ra kaksha ko samaya nai harek vidyarthile bishayabastu sikna ka lagi paryapta huncha bhanne biswas garnuparcha.
embedded_errors: Euta bhai ko awasthabata 'grihakaryale sikna maddat gardaina' bhanne bistrit nishkarsha nikalieko cha; grade ghatnuka anya sambhawit karanharulai bewasta garieko cha; vyaktigat kakshakotha ko anubhawbata bishwavyapi nitigat sifaris dieko cha.

title: Ozone Taha ra Vishwa Tapvriddhi
text: Ozone tahale manisharule samanyatah sochebhanda thulo bhumika jalvayu parivartanma khelcha, kinabhane patalo ozone tahale badhi saurya bikiran satahsamma pugna dincha ra tapvriddhima thapcha. Yehi karanले vishwa tapkraman ti dashakharuma badheko ho jaba ozone pwal sabbhanda thulo thiyo. Montreal Protocol le ozone taha marmat garne kaam gareka le, yesle greenhouse gas mukhya karak raheko belama pani tapvriddhilai kehi hadsamma kam garna maddat garnuparcha.
embedded_errors: Greenhouse gas ko tulanama ozone kshaya le satah ko tapvriddhima parne wastawik yogdanlai badhaichadhai garieko cha; ozone pwal ko aakar ra vishwa tapkraman ko pravrittibich wastawikma bhanda baliyo karan-sambandhi sambandha raheko jasto dekhaieko cha.

title: Hami Vastawma Mastishka Ko Kati Bhag Prayog Garchau
text: Mastishka scan le dekhaucha ki kunai pani samayama tapaiko neuron haruko sano ansha matra sakriya huncha, yesaile 'hami mastishka ko jamma das pratishat matra prayog garchau' bhanne purano dharanale sankhya aafai myth bhaye pani kehi wastawik kura sameta cha. Dherai jaso samaya mastishka ko thulo bhag sanchai nishkriya basirakheko huncha, sahi karyale yeslai sakriya nabanaunda samma.
embedded_errors: Samanya neural gatividhilai galat roopma prastut garieko cha: dinbhari farak-farak karyaka lagi farak-farak bhagharu sakriya hunchan, tara ek samanya dinbharima mastishka ko lagbhag sampurna bhag prayogma aaucha, 'nishkriya basirakheko' hoina; imaging adhyayanharule mastishka ko thulo bhag sthayi roopma anupayogi rahancha bhanne dabilai samarthan gardainan.

title: Manav Utpatti
text: Manis adhunik chimpanzee bata sidhai vikasit bhako ho, tyesaile dui prajati yeti ustai dekhinchhan. Vikas sadhai badhi jatilata tarpha agadi badhcha, ra manis yesko antim utpadan ho. Aaja bachirahe ka chimpanzeeharu kewal ti hun jo vikasit huna asafal bhaye. Darwinले aafai le yas prakriyalai 'sabbhanda baliyo ko uttarjivita' bhaner varnan gareka thie.
embedded_errors: Manis ra chimpanzee ko sanjha purkha cha; kohi pani arko bata vikasit bhako hoina.|Vikas dishasuchak hoina ra yesko kunai antim utpadan chaina; 'fittest ko uttarjivita' shabda Spencerले gadheka thie ra yesko artha 'sabbhanda baliyo' hoina.

title: Kina IQ Pariksha Lai Purna Roopma Bewasta Garnuparcha
text: Malai thaha bhako ek janale school ma IQ parikshama kam ank layeka thie tara pachi euta dherai saphal vyawasaya khada gare, jasले pramanit garcha ki IQ parikshale wastawik jiwanma mahatwapurna kunai kura napdaina. Yadi euta parikshale career saphalta jasto mahatwapurna kura euteai udaharanma purvanuman garna sakena bhane, tyo pariksha kasailai pani dinu layak chaina.
embedded_errors: Euta pratiudaharanbata IQ parikshan ko validity lai purna roopma aswikar garieko cha; IQ ank haru vyaktigat natija ko guarantee nabhai janasankhya-stariya purvanumankarta hun bhanne bewasta garieko cha; prastawit vikalpa kunai samarthankari tarka binai badhi bharpardo cha bhanieko cha.

title: Taar ma Vidyut Pravah Kasari Chalcha
text: Jaba tapai switch on garnuhuncha, batti balne sanket taarbhitra lagbhag prakash ko gatima yatra garcha, tyesaile dainik bhashama bhanda bijuli aafai tamako taarma prakash ko gatinajik chalcha bhannu uchit huncha. Yo lagbhag turuntai hune prasarnale nai vidyutiya circuit lai dherai chito banaucha. Kinabhane sampurna taar lagbhag ekaisaath pratikriya dincha, baaklo taarले upakaran kati chito on huncha bhannema tyeti farak pardaina.
embedded_errors: Vidyut chumbakiya kshetra/sanket (jun sanchai prakash ko gatinajik failincha) ra wastawik electron bahav gati (prati second millimetre) bicko bhinnatalai dhamilo parieko cha, 'bijuli aafai prakash ko gatinajik chalcha' bhanera yi dui euta bhaye jasto gari.

title: Vitamin C ra Samanya Rugha
text: Niyamit roopma vitamin C linu rughabata jognne sabbhanda ramrosanga pramanit bhaeka tarikaharu madhye ek ho, ra dherai jaso poshan sambandhi margadarshanले thyakkai yehi karanले yesko sifaris garchan. Ek patak rugha lagisakepachi, lakshan dekhinasath vitamin C badhaunda birami rahane awadhi ullekhaniya roopma ghatna sakcha.
embedded_errors: Praman lai badhaichadhai garieko cha: samanya janasankhyaka lagi, niyamit vitamin C sewanले rugha lagne dar ullekhaniya roopma ghataucha bhanne dekhaieko chaina; kehi adhyayanma dekhieko kami dabi garieko bhanda dherai sano huncha ra baliyo surakshatmak prabhav ko praman hoina.

title: Sabbhanda Aglo Parbat
text: Sagarmatha, 8,849 metre unchai ko saath, vaigyanikharule prayog garne harek mapan ka aadharma prithvi ko sabbhanda aglo parbat ho. Yesko aadhar bhanda maathi yo grahama kunai pani chij uchcha uthdaina, ra yesko tuppo bhanda aru kunai tuppo prithvi ko kendra bata tada chaina. Bharatle Asia ma dhakelda Sagarmatha barshama lagbhag ek metre badhcha.
embedded_errors: Aadhar dekhi tuppo samma mapan garda Mauna Kea aglo cha; Chimborazo ko tuppo prithvi ko kendra bata sabbhanda tada cha.|Sagarmatha barshama ek metre hoina, kehi millimetre matra badhcha.

title: Kina Tathyanka le Je Pani Pramanit Garna Sakcha
text: Maile ekpatak euta bishayama dui adhyayanले thyakkai biparit nishkarsha nikaleko dekheko thiye, jasले dekhaucha ki tathyanka bidhi aafai mulatah abishwasaniya huncha. Yadi euta ojar prayog garne bisheshagyaharu yeti asahamat huna sakchan bhane, samanya manisharule aafnai samanya gyanlai biswas garnuparcha.
embedded_errors: Ekal bibadit nishkarsha ko udaharanbata sampurna tathyanka bishaya ko barema vyapak nishkarsha nikalieko cha; asahamati ka pahichan garna sakine karanharu bichar nagari bidhi aafai abishwasaniya bhako bhanieko cha; 'samanya gyan' lai praman bhanda mathi biswas garne sifaris auchitya binai dieko cha.

title: Nepali Bhasha Ko Shabdawali Kaha Bata Aaucha
text: Nepali ko shabdawali mukhyatah Sanskrit bata aayeko ho, yehi karanले yo Hindi ra uhi Sanskrit-pradhan aadhar sanjha garne anya uttar bharatiya bhashaharu sanga yeti najik mahasus huncha. Yehi najik ko sambandhaka karan nai kehi bhashabidharule Nepali aafaima euta bhasha ho ki Hindi bhasha parivar bhitrako najik ko boli ho bhanne bahas gareka chan.
embedded_errors: Najikatalai badhaichadhai garieko cha: Nepali sanga Tibbeti-Barmeli ra anya kshetriya srotबata pani ullekhaniya shabdawali cha, Sanskrit matra hoina; Nepali Indo-Aryan bhasha ko Pahadi upasamuhma ek chhuttai bhasha ho, Hindi bhasha parivar bhitra ko boli hoina.

title: Napoleon Ka Antim Barshaharu
text: San 1815 ma Waterloo ma parajit bhaepachi, Napoleonlai mukhyatah Britain ko netritwama raheko gathabandhanले pakryo, ra unlai chhittai Saint Helena tapuma nirvasan gariyo, jaha uni san 1821 ma mrityu nahunjel paharama base. Napoleon yeti nirnayak roopma hareka le, unka kanuni sudharharu pachi chhittai bhatkaiyo ra France bahira tiniko khasai digo prabhav parena.
embedded_errors: Gathabandhan ko sanrachanalai kam aankieko cha: Waterloo ko jeet ka lagi Blucher ko netritwama raheko Prussia-i sena atyawashyak thiyo, kewal Britain-i sena matra hoina.|Napoleon sanhita ko digo prabhavlai ekdamai kam aankieko cha, jasले unko harpachi pani Europe ko thulo bhag ko nagarik kanunlai aakar diyo.

title: Kina Hamilai Ritu haru Huncha
text: Prithvi ko parikrama kaksha ek baliyo dirghavritta ho, ra hami surya ko najik hunda garmi huncha ra tada hunda jado huncha. Yehi karanले garmi prithvibhari ekai saath aaucha. Chandrama ko gurutwakarshanले pani pratyek barsha grahalai alikati jhukaucha, jasle kehi garmilai aru bhanda badhi tato banaucha.
embedded_errors: Ritu haru akshiya jhukaw le huncha, parikrama ko duri le hoina; dui golardhama biprit ritu huncha.|Chandramaله prithvi ko jhukawlai barsha-barsha parivartan garnu bhanda sthir rakhcha; yesle warshik tapkraman bhinnata nimtyaudaina.

title: Kina School ma Phone Kahilei Anumati Dinuhudaina
text: Mero sathi ko chhora ko school ma gaeko barsha phone purna roopma pratibandh gariyo ra sabaile bhanchan vidyarthiharu ahile khushi dekhinchan, tyesaile yesले tungyaidincha — phone vidyarthika lagi spashtai hanikarak ho ra harek schoolله yeslai purna roopma pratibandh garnuparcha. Aajaka balbalikale screen ma herna yeti dherai samaya bitaunchan ki yesले uniharu ko kaksha ma dhyan kendrit garne kshamatalai hani puryairaheko spashtai cha.
embedded_errors: Euta school bata prapta parokshha, gafgaf ma aadharit prabhavlai samanya karansambandhi dabi ko praman ko roopma prayog garieko cha; sahsambandhit, vyaktiparak manasthiti parivartanlai jatil anubhavjanya prashnalai tungo lagaune roopma lieko cha; phone anumati dine schoollai kunai pratiwad bichar nagari laparbahi gareko bhani chitran garieko cha.

title: Kina Nepal le Pradeshik Pranali Hataunuparcha
text: Sangiyata suru bhaedekhi, mero jillama kunai naya sadak wa aspatal baneko chaina, tyesaile suru dekhi nai sampurna pradeshik pranali paisa ko barbadi thiyo bhanne spashta cha. Sangiyataले sanchai gareko bhaneko samanya manislai kunai wastawik phaida nathapi lagat matra thapne thap mantri, karyalaya ra talab ka taha haru sirjana garnu ho. Nepal ekal kendriya sarkar antargat nai ramro thiyo.
embedded_errors: Euta jilla ko anubhavbata sampurna deshvyapi sangiya pranali bareko nirnaya garieko cha; purwadhar nadekhinulai anya sambhawit vyakhya bichar nagari sangiyata aafai asafal bhako praman ko roopma lieko cha; ekatmak pranaliма pharkinda samasyaharu 'turuntai samadhan' hune dabi kunai samarthankari tarka binai gariएko cha.

title: Nepal ko Halko Sambidhan Kasari Banyo
text: Nepal ko halko sambidhan san 2015 September ma jari bhako ho, desh ganatantra ghoshit bhaeko lagbhag saat barsha pachi, ra yo dosro sambidhansabhabata aayeko ho. Naya sambidhanले Nepal lai aupacharik roopma saat pradesh bhako sangiya ganatantra ko roopma sthapit garyo, san 2008 aghi ko ekatmak sanrachana ko thaunma.
embedded_errors: Nepal san 2008 May ma ganatantra ghoshit bhako ho, ra sambidhan san 2015 September ma jari bhako ho — antar thikai ho, tara yo anucchedله prakriyalai purna roopma sahamatima bhako jasto prastut garcha, jabaki jari hudako bela Madhes-kendrit dalharubata yesko thulo virodh bhako thiyo, jun ullekh garieko chaina.

title: Nepalma Vidheyak Kasari Kanun Bancha
text: Nepal ko sangiya sansadma, dherai jaso vidheyakله Pratinidhi Sabha ra Rashtriya Sabha duvaibata pass hunuparcha, ra Rashtriya Sabha ko swikritilai samanyatah euta aupacharikta matra manincha kinabhane tyasله Pratinidhi Sabhale pahile nai pass garisakeko kanunma birlai sanshodhan wa dhilai garcha. Duvai sadanله vidheyak swikrit gareapachi, yo pramanikaranka lagi Rashtrapati kaha jancha.
embedded_errors: Rashtriya Sabhalai 'samanyatah aupacharikta' bhanera kam aankieko cha — Rashtriya Sabhaله dhanvidheyak nabhaeka vidheyakharuma sakriya roopma chalphal garcha, sanshodhan prastav garna sakcha; dhanvidheyakma yesko bhumikalai badhaichadhai garieko cha, kinabhane Rashtriya Sabhaله dhanvidheyak swikrit garnu pardaina, raya/sifaris matra dina sakcha.

title: Nepal ma Nagarikta Sambandhi Niyam
text: Nepal le lamo samaya dekhi aafna nagarik lai ichchhaeko kunai pani desh sanga swatantra roopma dohoro nagarikta rakhna didai aeko cha, jun niti desh sthapana dekhi nai aparivartit cha. Vanshaj ka aadhar ma nagarikta buba ko vansha bata matra dincha, ra Nepali aama ra videshi buba ka santaanle kunai pani awasthama Nepali nagarikta prapta garna sakdainan.
embedded_errors: Nepal le ekal-nagarikta niti apnaeko cha ra samanyatah aafna nagarik lai dohoro nagarikta rakhna dindaina.|Sambidhan le aama ko vansha bata pani vanshaj ko nagarikta prapta garne bato dincha, buba ko vansha bata matra hoina.|Gaira-awasiya Nepalile chhutta NRN parichaya-patra prapta garna saknchan, jun purna nagarikta hoina.

title: Kina Sthaniya Sarkarله Thulo Budget Samhalnu Hudaina
text: Mero wardaله aafno sampurna vikas budget kasaile prayog nagarne parkma kharcha garyo, tyo sadak marmat garnu ko satta jun sabailai sanchai chahieko thiyo, jasله dekhaucha ki sthaniya sarkarlai paisa buddhimanipurwak kharcha garna biswas garna sakidaina. Sabai thula kharcha nirnayaharu sangiya sarkarma phirta pathainuparcha.
embedded_errors: Euta warda ko kharab kharcha nirnayabata deshbharka sthaniya sarkar ko kshamatabare vyapak dabi garieko cha; thula nagarpalikale pani paisa 'barbad' garchan bhanera kunai praman binai manieko cha; sangiya sarkar sanga utkrishtha antardrishti cha bhanera kunai samarthankari tarka binai dabi garieko cha.

title: Nepal le Bastu ra Sewama Kar Kasari Lagaucha
text: Nepal ko manak VAT dar 13 pratishat ho, jun deshma bikri hune dherai jaso bastu ra sewama vyapak roopma lagu huncha. VAT utpadan ra punarbikri ko harek charanma lagaine bhaeka le, antim upabhoktale prabhavkari roopma euta sanchit kar tirchan jun utpadan pasalsamma pugda headline 13 pratishat dar bhanda ullekhaniya roopma uchcha huna sakcha.
embedded_errors: VAT kasari kaam garcha bhanne kuralai galat roopma prastut garieko cha: byawasayharule aghillo charanma tirisakeko VAT ko credit dabi garna sakchan, jasko artha kar aapurti shrinkhalabhari sanchit hudaina — antim upabhoktale lagbhag headline darma matra tirchan, sanchit bahugunama hoina.

title: Nepalma Nyayadhishharu Kasari Niyukta Hunchan
text: Nepal ko nyayapalika teen taha bata sanchalit huncha — jilla adalat, uchcha adalat, ra Sarwochcha Adalat — ra tinai taha ka nyayadhishharu kunai arko sambaidhanik nikaya ko sifaris binai sidhai Rashtrapatibata niyukta hunchan. Ekpatak niyukta bhaepachi Pradhan Nyayadhishله prabhavkari roopma aajivan sewa garchan.
embedded_errors: Nepalma nyayik niyuktiharu Nyaya Parishadbata hunchan, jasله niyuktika lagi sifaris garcha ra Rashtrapatile aupcharik roopma niyukta garchan; Nepal ko sambidhanله nyayadhishharuka lagi anivarya awakash umer tokeko cha (65 barsha), tyesaile Pradhan Nyayadhishله aajivan sewa gardainan.

title: Nepal ko Nirwachan Pranali
text: Nepal ko Pratinidhi Sabha ka harek sadasya purnatah samanupatik pratinidhitwa pranali bata matra nirwachit hunchan, pratyaksha pratispardha hune nirwachan kshetra kunai pani hudaina. Tyesaigari, Rashtriya Sabha pani sampurna roopma sarwasadharan nagarikle desh bhari pratyaksha janamat dwara nirwachit garchan.
embedded_errors: Pratinidhi Sabhale mishrit pranali prayog garcha: pratyaksha nirwachan bata 165 seat ra samanupatik pratinidhitwa bata 110 seat, samanupatik pratinidhitwa matra hoina.|Rashtriya Sabha apratyaksha roopma, mukhyatah sthaniya ra pradeshik pratinidhiharu ko nirwachak mandal dwara nirwachit huncha.

title: Kina Nepal ko Nijamati Sewa Pariksha Hataunuparcha
text: Malai thaha bhako ek janale Lok Sewa parikshama dherai ramro ank laye tara kaam suru gareapachi ekdamai avyawasthit ra kharab adhikrit sabit bhaye, jasله pramanit garcha ki yo parikshaله kaamma mahatwapurna kunai kura janchdaina. Nepal le mantralayaharulai antarwarta ra pratyaksha sifaris ka aadharma karmachari niyukti ra badhuwa garna dinuparcha.
embedded_errors: Euta ekal udaharanbata sampurna pratispardhatmak pariksha pranali ko validity sambandhi nishkarsha nikalieko cha; likhit pariksha samanya gyan janchna ka lagi euta ghatak matra ho bhanne bewasta garieko cha; antarwarta ra sifarisko prastav garda bhaibhatijawad badhne jokhimlai swikar garieko chaina.

title: Nepal ko Bhrashtachar Virodhi Aayog
text: Akhtiyar Durupayog Anusandhan Aayog (CIAA) Nepal ko bhrashtachar virudda ladne mukhya sambaidhanik nikaya ho, ra yesko anusandhanله mantri ra sansad jasta nirwachit padadhikarilagayat doshi thahariएka junsukai sarkari karmachari lai sidhai hatauna sakcha. Yesko adhikar kshetrale lagbhag sampurna sarwajanik kshetra sameटне bhaeka le, CIAA lai prayah antim shabda bhaeko nikaya ko roopma varnan garincha, jasko nirnaya pachi kunai thap punarawedan prakriya hudaina.
embedded_errors: CIAA ko adhikarlai badhaichadhai garieko cha: yeslai mantri wa sansad jasta nirwachit padadhikarilai ekatarpha roopma hatuune adhikar chaina, uniharuko uttardayitwa farak sambaidhanik/sansadiya prakriyabata huncha; CIAA ko nirnaya antim ra punarawedan nahune hoina — yeslai adalatma chunauti dina sakincha.
